title: Lost Squeaky
hook: 洗澡玩具被挤飞，一路追到会喷黏浆的间歇泉。

cells.en: Boots has a new bath toy. He squeezes it and it squeaks!
cells.cn: Boots 有个新洗澡玩具，一捏就“吱吱”叫，他给它取名 Squeaky。

cells.en: Boots squeezes too hard, so Squeaky flies away. Can you help them?
cells.cn: 他挤得太用力，Squeaky 一下飞出双手，一路滚下山坡。

cells.en: Map says Squeaky is going to the Gooey Geyser. They must hurry!
cells.cn: 地图说 Squeaky 正飘向黏糊糊间歇泉，得赶快去追。

cells.en: First they go to Bubble Bridge. Come on, let's get to it!
cells.cn: 三个地方记牢：泡泡桥、泥巴山、间歇泉。先冲向泡泡桥。

cells.en: Big bubbles block the bridge. They pop, pop, pop them all!
cells.cn: 大泡泡把桥堵住了，他们用手指一个个戳破，才走过去。

cells.en: Tico drives them over Muddy Mountain. They shout “¡Para!” to stop!
cells.cn: 下一站泥巴山，Tico 开车载他们，看到泥浆就喊“¡Para!”（停）。

cells.en: The geyser shoots out pink goo. They keep looking for Squeaky.
cells.cn: 间歇泉喷出粉色的黏浆，大家打着伞继续找 Squeaky。

cells.en: Squeaky bounces out of the goo. Everyone shouts, “Squeeze him!”
cells.cn: Squeaky 从黏浆里蹦了出来，大家一起喊“快捏捏他”，把它接住。

cells.en: Boots is happy again. What a lucky day for little Squeaky!
cells.cn: Squeaky 回来了，Boots 又开心起来，大家一起欢呼。

opener: Today I watched Dora the Explorer. This episode is “Lost Squeaky”.
ending: In the end, Boots gets Squeaky back. My favorite part is ______.
